feeds.title: Canada Artistic Swimming
feeds.description: Our mission is to achieve excellence in all aspects of Artistic Swimming in Canada. We envision being a World leading nation in Artistic Swimming and inspiring and supporting all participants to realize their dreams in artistic swimming. We expect behaviour of the highest ethical standard, demonstrating accountability, integrity, respect and safety by all people in the sport.

feeds.title: Aqualillies Blog
feeds.description: Aqualillies is the world's most glamorous water entertainment company, reinventing the classic art form for the new millennium. Diving off the pages of Vogue, Marie Claire, and The New York Times, Aqualillies has become synonymous with beauty, sophistication, luxury, and style. Take a peek behind the scenes of the world's most glamorous water entertainment. Check out our blog for news, stories, and more!

feeds.title: Inside Synchro
feeds.description: Christina Marmet was a synchronized swimmer for 12 years. She swam in France for eight years before moving to the U.S. for university and continuing her synchro career there. In July 2016, she founded Inside Synchro to create a 'one-stop shop' about the sport. She aims to bring the best coverage, features, interviews, and databases for all the synchro-nerds and casual viewers.

feeds.title: Pirouettes Of Texas Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1985, PTX is the oldest and most decorated synchronized swimming club in North Texas. We identify and develop the next generation of talented athletes, and instill its members with the confidence, discipline, sportsmanship, and poise, needed to face any of life's challenges.

feeds.title: Synchro New Brunswick Blog
feeds.description: Synchro New Brunswick is a volunteer-based committee that helps all New Brunswick synchronized swim clubs and is governed by Synchro Canada. Explore our blog to know our programs and more.

feeds.title: Aquabatix Blog
feeds.description: Aquabatix is the world's leading professional synchronised swimming team who produce innovative water entertainment for live events and underwater production projects globally. Fusing the glamour of Hollywood with the acrobatics of an Olympic sport, we have forged our very own aquatic niche within the entertainment industry.
